Package edu.odu.cs.cs350

Class Semester

java.lang.Object
edu.odu.cs.cs350.Semester
public class Semester extends Object
A Semester; for our purposes it is composed of a title, code, pre-registration and add-deadline dates, as well as several snapshots of enrollment relevent to the semester
